posts.title: Dear Annie
posts.description: Music Video: Dear Annie Dear Annie How are you? I know…you still miss me You thought Things would have changed If only you had known a little bit more back then But Annie Things happen for a reason Every tear you’ve shed Has not been wasted Though I am far from your touch I am never far from your soul I watch over you with joy Dear Annie I know that You want to share Many stories with me But Annie
